detail.description:
Excellent description of this run at [SouthwestPaddler.com](http://southwestpaddler.com/docs/riograndenm3.html) and at [New Mexico Bureau of Land Management Rivers Page](http://www.emnrd.state.nm.us/PRD/BOATINGWeb/BoatingwatersriverrunningNewMexico.htm).

**Put-in info:** Put-in longitude and Lattitude coordinates might be off.

Here is what the BLM says about Lee Trail:

0.25 miles one-way

Elevation drop 200 feet

Moderate to difficult

Primarily used as main take-out for Ute Mountain run; wildlife; fishing

Access: South of Sunshine Valley Road

**Take-out info:**

BLM Chiflo Trail:

0.5 miles one-way

Elevation drop 320 feet

Moderate

Shorter access to river

Bring your hiking shoes to boat this one.

The reaches of the Taos Box area are...

[Ute Mountain](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/1222/) (Class II),

[Razors](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/1223/) (Class III/IV),

[Upper Box](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/1224/) (Class V/V+),

[Lower Box](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/1227/) (Class III/IV),

[Pilar](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/1228/) (Class III/IV),

[Otowi Bridge](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/1225/) (Class III),

[Red River](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/3594/) (Class IV),

[Rio Pueblo](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/3598/) (Class V+), and

[Rio Embudo](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/rivers/id/3592/) (Class V+).
